preview.sceneLoadFailed: Couldn't load this scene. Its episode may have moved.

export.title: Export settings
export.davinciOn: Exported clips go to the DaVinci Resolve timeline
export.davinciOff: Send exported clips to the DaVinci Resolve timeline (Studio only)
export.davinciAria: Send exported clips to DaVinci Resolve
export.configurePostPasses: Configure post-export passes in export settings. Turning this off keeps your configuration.
export.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one clip to export

steps.select: Select clips with {{mod}} + Click, Shift + Click, or Double Click
steps.exportNow: Click Export Now to export what you picked

scenepacks.create: Create a Scenepack in the left panel
scenepacks.add: In the Library, select clips and click Add to Scenepack
scenepacks.open: Open a Scenepack to see its clips

sceneScoutSearch.database: Create or open a Database in the left panel
sceneScoutSearch.searching: Move it into Searching: Double Click it, drag it up, or right click it. Only databases in Searching are searched
sceneScoutSearch.addEpisode: Click Add Episode to index episodes into it
sceneScoutSearch.describe: Describe a scene in the search bar and press Enter
sceneScoutSearch.preview: Single click a result to Preview it

sceneScoutFlow.import: Click Import, or right-click a clip and pick Find matching clips
sceneScoutFlow.matches: Matches are scenes that look like they continue from your clip's last frame
sceneScoutFlow.resize: Drag the line between your clip and the matches to resize them
sceneScoutFlow.preview: Single click a match to Preview it

library.start: Click Export Now to start the process
